topics.title: Stellarator holds plasma 40 minutes, a record
topics.summary: A research stellarator sustained a stable plasma for 40 minutes, four times its previous best, thanks to a new tungsten wall coating. The lab plans a one-hour campaign at higher density next spring. Net energy gain remains years away.
topics.detail: Engineers credited the tungsten coating for shedding less material into the plasma, extending the shot duration. Two outside physicists called the result real but incremental. The lab announced a spring 2027 campaign aiming for a one-hour pulse at higher density.

sources.title: Test stellarator holds plasma for a record 40 minutes
Le stellarator d'essai bat son record de durée

topics.new_development: The seabed authority has now scheduled a formal vote on a 10-year moratorium for its November session, with the agenda published for 12 November.
topics.title: Seabed authority schedules moratorium vote
topics.summary: An international seabed body agreed to vote on a 10-year commercial deep-sea mining moratorium at its November session. Twelve member states back the pause, while two companies with exploration contracts say it would breach existing agreements. The vote is set for 12 November.
topics.detail: The council agreed on Monday to put the moratorium to a vote, and the published agenda confirms the vote for 12 November. A two-thirds majority is required for passage. Two companies holding exploration contracts argue a moratorium would violate their existing agreements.

sources.title: Seabed authority schedules a vote on a mining moratorium

topics.title: Chess federation trials shorter youth games
topics.summary: A national chess federation will trial 45-minute games with a 10-second increment at three youth events this winter, citing shorter attention spans and travel costs. Coaches are split on the change.
topics.detail: The federation announced the trial for three youth events this winter, replacing longer time controls. Officials cited shorter attention spans and travel costs as reasons. Coaches quoted in the report were divided, with some welcoming the change and others concerned about game quality.

sources.title: Chess federation tests a shorter time control for youth events
